description: This is a PHP unit test class for the PurgeStrategy component within the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin. It tests functionalities such as retrieving the purge service, match values, records, parameters, entity class name, and entity field map.

classes.name: PurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing PurgeStrategy functionalities in the OrangeHRM Maintenance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, mocks the PurgeStrategy, and populates test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetPurgeEmployeeService
methods.description: Tests that getPurgeService returns an instance of PurgeService.

methods.name: testGetMatchByValues
methods.description: Verifies that getMatchByValues returns expected match parameters.

methods.name: testGetPurgeRecords
methods.description: Checks that getEntityRecords retrieves correct entity records based on match criteria.

methods.name: testGetParameters
methods.description: Ensures getParameters returns the correct list of parameters.

methods.name: testGetEntityClassName
methods.description: Checks that getEntityClassName returns the correct class name.

methods.name: testGetEntityFieldMap
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityFieldMap returns the correct mapping.
